exam_scheme.note: UPCET (formerly UPSEE, conducted by NTA for the Government of Uttar Pradesh / AKTU Lucknow) is the state-level entrance examination for admission into undergraduate professional programs (B.Pharm, B.Des, BHMCT, BFA, BFAD, B.Voc), postgraduate courses (MCA, MBA, M.Tech), and lateral entry to B.Tech/B.Pharm across all participating technical universities in Uttar Pradesh (AKTU, MMMUT, HBTU).
